corrections.reason: The word is ተይዛ (held/kept, cf. L26 ተይዛ ፡ አየሁ), where the 6th-order ይ (with its right-side loop) was misread as ግ due to slight ink fill.
6th-order ስ in ስላመኑ ('because they believed', cf. L04 ስላመኑ) is clearly printed with the top-left notch of ስ, misread as 1st-order ሰ.
The cross-reference is ም ፡ ፯ ፥ ፲፭ (Revelation 7:15); the numeral ፯ (7) was misread as ፳ (20) and ፲፭ (15) was misread as ፭ (5).

corrections.old_text: ነው ፡ ም ፡ ፫ ፥ ፭ ፡ ፯ ፥ ፱ ፡ ፲፫ ፡ ፲፬ ።
corrections.corrected_text: ነው ፡ ም ፡ ፫ ፥ ፭ ፡ ፯ ፥ ፱ ፡ ፲፫ ፥ ፲፬ ።
corrections.reason: Between ፲፫ and ፲፬ there is a colon-dash separator (፥) rather than a plain wordspace.
The printed Fidel is 6th-order እ in ማእዜኑ (not ዕ), matching the canonical Ge'ez spelling in Col 1 L33 and Col 2 L25, L29.
